title: OpenTuringBench: An Open-Model-based Benchmark and Framework for Machine-Generated Text Detection and Attribution

one_line: Open benchmark relevant to attribution and audit of generated text under model shift.
以七类压力场景检验开源 LLM 生成文本的检测与作者归因鲁棒性。

title: Problem
问题
html:
Machine-generated text threatens provenance, misinformation control, and future training-data hygiene, yet detectors are often tested only on familiar generators and clean in-domain prose. Such results do not show whether a detector survives rewrites, human–machine mixtures, new model families, or a domain shift.

OpenTuringBench supplies a public evaluation and training resource for both binary human-versus-machine detection and multi-class authorship attribution. It also introduces a contrastive detector so that the benchmark exposes concrete failure modes rather than merely reporting one easy classification score.

机器生成文本会损害内容来源判断、错误信息治理和后续训练语料卫生，但现有检测器常只在熟悉生成模型和干净的同域文本上测试。这样的分数无法说明系统能否经受改写、人机混合、新模型家族或领域迁移。

OpenTuringBench 为“人类／机器”二分类和多类别作者归因提供公开训练、评测资源，并给出对比学习检测器，使基准能暴露具体失效模式，而非只报告一道容易分类题的分数。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The paper contributes OpenTuringBench, an open-model machine-generated-text benchmark that pairs human news with outputs from seven open LLMs and tests detection and attribution under seven scenarios. The official dataset contains 543,091 English texts (41,426 human and 501,665 machine) and supports TT binary classification and AA multi-class attribution. OTBDetector uses Longformer representations, triplet contrastive learning, and nearest-centroid classification; the public Hugging Face release is the official reusable dataset.

论文的核心对象是 OpenTuringBench：一个面向开源模型机器文本的基准，将人类新闻与 7 个开源 LLM 输出配对，并在 7 类情景下测试检测和归因。官方数据集含 543,091 条英文文本，其中人类文本 41,426 条、机器文本 501,665 条，支持 TT 二分类与 AA 多类别归因。OTBDetector 以 Longformer 表征、三元组对比学习和最近质心分类工作；Hugging Face 发布页是官方可复用数据集。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Collect a source corpus. Start from human-written HuffPost news and generate counterpart texts with seven open instruction models; labels identify human or generator authorship.
  1. Define stress tests. Partition data into in-domain E0, temperature, scale, self-rewrite, and human-machine-mixing variants E1–E4, plus essay-domain E5 and unseen-generator E6 tests.
  1. Train OTBDetector. Encode long texts with Longformer, form anchor-positive-negative triplets by authorship label, and optimize triplet loss so same-author examples cluster while different labels separate.
  1. Attribute at inference. Pre-compute class centroids from train embeddings and assign a query to its nearest cosine-similarity centroid; the label is the detector decision.
  1. Compare fairly. Train every detector only on the benchmark train split, fine-tune model-based baselines for ten epochs, and report weighted precision, recall, and F1 on each test task. Reproduction requires the released split, generator versions, preprocessing, and task configuration; license details should be checked on the dataset page.

1. 收集源语料。以人类撰写的 HuffPost 新闻为起点，用 7 个开源指令模型生成对应文本，标签记录人类或生成模型作者身份。
  1. 定义压力测试。数据分为同域 E0、温度、规模、自改写和人机混合变体 E1–E4，以及作文领域 E5、未见生成器 E6。
  1. 训练 OTBDetector。用 Longformer 编码长文本，按作者类别构造锚点—正例—负例三元组，以 triplet loss 拉近同类、分开异类。
  1. 推理归因。由训练嵌入预计算各类别质心，再按余弦相似度把查询分到最近质心；该标签即检测结论。
  1. 公平比较。所有检测器只用训练切分，模型型 baseline 微调 10 个 epoch，并在各任务上报加权 precision、recall、F1。复现须固定发布切分、生成模型版本、预处理和任务配置；许可应在数据页另行核验。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Claim: common detection success hides substantial robustness gaps, while OTBDetector is competitive across the proposed stress tests. All methods train on the same OpenTuringBench train split; the paper compares nine competing detectors using weighted F1 for TT and AA tasks.

TT is easy in the conventional setting, where F1 consistently exceeds 0.90. In contrast, human continuation is extremely difficult: the best F1 is only 0.15. After self-rewriting, OTBDetector still reaches 0.871 F1 and outperforms alternatives. These results support the benchmark’s value for exposing shift, but do not show reliable attribution across languages or arbitrary generators.

核心主张是：常规检测成功掩盖了显著的鲁棒性缺口，而 OTBDetector 在所设压力测试中保持竞争力。所有方法使用同一 OpenTuringBench 训练切分，论文以加权 F1 比较 9 个竞争检测器在 TT、AA 任务上的表现。

常规 TT 很容易，F1 持续超过 0.90；人类续写却极难，最佳 F1 仅 0.15。经过自改写后，OTBDetector 仍达 0.871 F1 并优于其他方法。这支持该基准揭示分布变化的价值，但不能证明它能在多语言或任意未知生成器上可靠归因。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier MGT benchmarks commonly emphasize detection under fixed generators or adversarial edits. OpenTuringBench changes the evaluation object by unifying binary detection and generator attribution over open LLM outputs, then adding controlled temperature, scale, rewrite, mixing, domain-shift, and unseen-generator conditions. OTBDetector itself extends a prior contrastive approach with Longformer for texts often longer than 1,000 tokens; the main novelty is the benchmark’s stress-test contract and public scale.
既有机器文本基准多在固定生成器或对抗改写下评测检测。OpenTuringBench 改变评测对象：把开源 LLM 输出上的二分类检测与生成器归因统一起来，并加入温度、规模、改写、混合、领域迁移和未见生成器等受控条件。OTBDetector 则以 Longformer 扩展既有对比学习方案，以处理常超过 1,000 token 的文本；主要新意是压力测试契约和公开规模。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The benchmark is centered on English news. Domain-specific writing and other languages can change both surface cues and detector behavior, so a high benchmark score should not be reused as a provenance claim for another corpus; test the target domain first.

Adding a newly released generator requires retraining OTBDetector, which becomes inefficient as model families proliferate. The authors also show that human continuation sharply weakens all systems; deployment should report this failure mode and avoid presenting detector output as conclusive authorship evidence.

该基准以英文新闻为中心。领域写作和其他语言会改变表层线索与检测器行为，因此不能把高分直接当作另一语料的来源证明；应先测试目标领域。

每加入新发布的生成器都要重训 OTBDetector，模型家族增多时会变得低效。作者还显示人类续写会显著削弱所有系统；部署时应报告这一失效，并避免把检测输出表述为确定的作者身份结论。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use the released data to benchmark an MGT detector or provenance classifier before using it for dataset hygiene. Load the matching in-domain, variation, or OOD configuration, train only on the designated split, and report weighted F1 separately for TT and AA; success requires retaining performance under the relevant shift, not just E0.

For a training-data audit, run the detector as a screening signal and manually inspect uncertain or high-impact cases, especially mixed human-machine text. Do not use it as a universal plagiarism or authorship verdict when the corpus is non-English, non-news, or generated by unrepresented systems.

若要在数据卫生前评估机器文本检测器或来源分类器，可使用公开数据：加载对应的同域、变体或 OOD 配置，只在指定训练切分上训练，并分别报告 TT、AA 的加权 F1；成功标准是在相关分布变化下仍保留性能，而不是只看 E0。

做训练语料审计时，可把检测器当筛查信号，并人工检查不确定或高影响案例，尤其是人机混合文本。若语料不是英文新闻，或生成器不在覆盖范围内，不能把它当作通用的抄袭或作者身份裁决。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. OpenTuringBench tests whether machine-text detection and generator attribution survive realistic distribution shifts.
  2. Its mechanism is labeled human/open-LLM text -> stress-task split -> Longformer triplet embeddings -> nearest-centroid decision.
  3. The official dataset has 543,091 English texts from seven open LLMs plus humans; it exposes TT and AA tasks E0–E6.
  4. Evidence anchor: all conventional TT F1 values exceed 0.90, but human continuation peaks at 0.15; OTBDetector reaches 0.871 after self-rewriting.
  5. Reuse it for detector validation and audit screening, but first check language/domain fit and report the mixed-text failure mode.

1. 一句话定位：该基准检验机器文本检测和生成器归因能否经受真实的分布变化。
  2. 方法抓手：带标签的人类／开源 LLM 文本进入压力任务切分，经 Longformer 三元组嵌入后由最近质心决策。
  3. 数据抓手：官方数据含 543,091 条英文文本、7 个开源 LLM 与人类来源，覆盖 TT、AA 的 E0–E6。
  4. 证据锚点：常规 TT 的 F1 都超过 0.90，但人类续写最高仅 0.15；自改写后 OTBDetector 为 0.871。
  5. 复用决定：适合检测器验证和审计筛查；先核对语言／领域匹配，并报告人机混合文本失效。
